tunnelConfig.fileFirst: Save these two credentials once. When the runtime is ready, CodexLink automatically prepares the Secure Link.
tunnelConfig.keepKey: Leave blank to keep the saved Runtime Key
tunnelConfig.storage: The Runtime Key is protected with Windows CurrentUser DPAPI and is never returned to the UI, ordinary state, or logs. Leave this blank to keep the saved key.
tunnelConfig.useEnvironment: Clear saved configuration and use environment
tunnelConfig.saved: Tunnel credentials were saved securely and applied.
tunnelConfig.sourceInvalid: Saved configuration is unreadable or invalid. Save it again or clear it. Environment fallback is disabled until repaired.
workspace.stopToRetry: Stop this tunnel, then start it again. If it still fails, check configuration below and the network proxy in Settings.
workspace.description: Your local project is ready to continue working through ChatGPT.
workspace.prepareHint: Choose a folder and start the runtime.
workspace.verifyHint: In ChatGPT, ask: List CodexLink projects, find my selected project and list its top-level files. If it is empty, report that.
workspace.handoffOne: Use Copy Tunnel ID above, or select the ID and copy it manually.
workspace.handoffTwo: Choose Tunnel in the ChatGPT connection setup, enter your Tunnel ID, and select None for authentication.

activation.title: Activate CodexLink
activation.firstUse: Complete device activation before using CodexLink for the first time.
activation.recoveryBody: Activation on this device could not be verified. Enter the activation code you received with your purchase again. If recovery still fails, contact support.
activation.revokedBody: The CodexLink license on this device has been stopped. If you have questions, contact support@syzdq.xyz.
activation.codeHelp: Enter the MYWS activation code you received with your purchase.
activation.error: Activation could not be completed. Try again.
activation.errorInvalid: That activation code is not valid. Check the MYWS code from your purchase message.
activation.errorBoundElsewhere: This activation code is already bound to another device. A new device requires a new license.
activation.errorStopped: This activation code has been stopped. If you have questions, contact support@syzdq.xyz.
activation.errorRateLimited: Too many activation attempts were made. Wait a moment and try again.
activation.errorUnavailable: The CodexLink activation service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
activation.errorNetwork: CodexLink could not reach the activation service. Check your network connection and try again.
activation.errorLocalStore: CodexLink could not save local activation data. Check access to the CodexLinkSecretKey folder and retry.
activation.errorDevice: Activation data for this device is missing or invalid. Re-enter the original activation code or contact support.

home.runtimeOwnership: CodexLink stops only processes it started. Existing user-managed processes are left alone.

first.title: How do you want to use this computer?
first.description: Choose a project, prepare the runtime, and let your AI client get to work.
first.localDescription: For everyday use. Choose your project and Desktop will prepare its runtime on this computer.
first.remoteDescription: Already have a team or self-hosted Server? Connect it to use projects on this computer.
first.shareDescription: Start a temporary one-project session that ends together when you stop it.
setup.localDescription: First, choose the actual project folder. Desktop will prepare its runtime and verify that the project is ready.
setup.remoteDescription: The Server stays remote. Desktop enrolls and supervises only this computer's Runner.
setup.shareDescription: Connect one project temporarily. Stopping the share also ends its temporary runtime.
setup.serverUrlHelp: Enter the http(s) origin of the existing CodexLink Server.
setup.reuseEnrollmentHelp: Desktop will reuse this computer's existing connection to the Server; the new project does not need another login code.
setup.pairingCodeHelp: The code is used only for this pairing attempt and is cleared from the UI immediately after submission.
provider.openaiDescription: OpenAI Secure Tunnel when already configured
setup.projectRequired: Choose the real directory ChatGPT should use before starting setup.
setup.advancedEnrollmentHelp: Shared key and existing profile remain owned by the canonical CodexLink connect lifecycle. Desktop does not copy bootstrap or admin credentials. Full GUI integration remains a D3 item.
setup.verifying: Desktop is verifying the real Service, Runner, and project state.
powershell7.title: PowerShell 7 is recommended
powershell7.fallbackAvailable: pwsh.exe was not detected. CodexLink will keep using Windows PowerShell 5.1 as a compatibility fallback, so setup is not blocked. After PowerShell 7 is installed, newly started Runners prefer pwsh.exe by default.
powershell7.fallbackUnavailable: Neither pwsh.exe nor the Windows PowerShell compatibility fallback was detected. Install PowerShell 7 before starting the local Runner.
powershell7.restartHint: If a new installation is still not detected, fully quit and reopen CodexLink to refresh its process environment.
setup.connectChatGptAfterSetupHelp: Starts OpenAI Secure Tunnel automatically and remembers this choice for the next Desktop launch.
setup.reloadProjectHelp: Desktop reapplies exact project access and activates it on the current Runner; only a legacy or incompatible Runner needs to be refreshed.
project.title: Projects on this computer
project.description: CodexLink file read/edit and project operations are limited to paths you explicitly add. Development shell/process commands run with the current Windows user permissions and are not a project-directory filesystem sandbox.
project.none: No project has been configured yet.
connection.title: ChatGPT Connection
connection.description: External reachability is separate from CodexLink permissions. A secure tunnel does not grant additional execution authority.
connection.chatgptAccessibleHelp: OpenAI Secure Tunnel is verified and can be used by ChatGPT.
connection.observedDescription: A real ChatGPT CodexLink call to the current project has been observed. This is tracked separately from Desktop-managed Tunnel state.
connection.notVerified: Desktop has not observed a ChatGPT call to the current project yet; this is not the same as “not connected.”
connection.localDescription: Keep the CodexLink runtime running without a Desktop-managed ChatGPT Tunnel. Other existing connection paths are not disabled.
connection.openaiDescription: Connect ChatGPT through the official OpenAI Secure Tunnel.
connection.waitingForChatGpt: The local Tunnel is ready and waiting for ChatGPT. After connecting, use one real project read as the final verification.
connection.tunnelHandoffNeedsAction: Secure tunnel is running, but the connection handoff still needs attention
connection.runtimeRequired: Make the local CodexLink Service, Runner, and project ready first.
connection.openaiNotConfigured: Required OpenAI Tunnel configuration is not currently detected.
connection.quickShareManaged: The current connection belongs to the temporary Quick Share session.
activity.title: Recent runtime activity
activity.description: A bounded, secret-redacted history of Desktop lifecycle events. Raw terminal output is not mirrored here.
activity.noMatches: No matching activity. Adjust your search or filters.
activity.processObservationFailed: Desktop could not observe the managed process
activity.remoteConnecting: Connecting to the existing CodexLink Server
activity.remoteConnected: This computer is connected to the existing CodexLink Server
activity.quickShareStarting: Starting the temporary Quick Share runtime
activity.regularTunnelReady: OpenAI Secure Tunnel is locally ready; waiting for ChatGPT
activity.operationCancelRequested: Stop requested for the current Desktop operation
settings.title: CodexLink Settings
settings.description: Manage the interface, startup behavior, and OpenAI Tunnel settings.
settings.launchAtLoginHelp: Starts CodexLink in the background. Your existing runtime preferences decide whether the local runtime and ChatGPT connection are restored.
tunnelConfig.title: Tunnel credentials
tunnelConfig.processScope: The checks below show whether the effective configuration is complete, without displaying secret values.
tunnelConfig.restartRequired: If you just set environment variables: closing the window only hides CodexLink in the tray/menu bar and does not refresh process environment. Fully quit CodexLink, then start it again, or launch it from a Terminal that already has those variables loaded.
tunnelConfig.macosShell: macOS: apps launched from Finder / Dock do not read ~/.zshrc. Recheck does not execute shell startup scripts either.
settings.tunnelProxyAutoHelp: Automatic mode checks Desktop proxy settings and the Windows system proxy, then selects a route that can reach the OpenAI control plane; no fixed proxy port is assumed.
settings.tunnelProxyCustomHelp: HTTP/HTTPS proxy without embedded credentials, for example http://127.0.0.1:7890. Port 7890 is only an example; use the port from your proxy app. This affects OpenAI Tunnel only.
settings.tunnelProxyAutoPending: Automatically select a usable route at startup
settings.binariesPending: Binaries are checked when setup or diagnostics first needs them.
error.binaryAction: Check the source-matched CodexLink binaries, then retry.
error.serverAction: Check Server status and network reachability, then retry.
error.runtimeAction: Restore the CodexLink Service, Runner, and project readiness, then retry.
error.runnerAction: Check the Runner connection to the Server, then retry.
error.projectAction: Use Activate project. Desktop will reapply exact project access and converge the project on the current Runner.
error.projectRemovalTitle: Project access could not be removed
error.projectRemovalAction: Check the current Runner and project authorization, then retry. If a broader parent directory still grants access, remove that broader authorization first.
error.pairingAction: Enter the wc_pair_… code issued by the existing Server.
error.enrollmentAction: Check the Server and enrollment details, then retry.
error.tunnelAction: Check OpenAI Tunnel configuration and network access, then retry.
error.tunnelNetworkAction: This network cannot reach OpenAI. Start the proxy you normally use, or open Settings → OpenAI Tunnel network and choose a working proxy/direct route, then retry.
error.processTitle: Managed process could not start or stop
error.processAction: Check Activity and confirm the CodexLink binaries are executable, then retry.
error.contractTitle: Desktop and CodexLink contracts do not match
error.contractAction: Make sure Desktop and all three CodexLink binaries use the same source revision.
error.topologyTitle: This operation is not supported by the current runtime topology
error.topologyAction: Use Local Full Runtime, or manage external reachability on the remote Server.
error.operationBusyTitle: Another Desktop operation is still running
error.operationBusyAction: Wait for the current operation to finish, or stop it first.
error.operationStaleAction: Refresh state before stopping the operation you currently observe.
error.operationCancelledAction: Observe the current state before retrying any step whose outcome was not confirmed.
tunnelConfig.invalidInput: Enter a valid Tunnel ID (letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens) and an API key without spaces.
tunnelConfig.saveFailed: Could not save configuration. Check write access to the local application data directory and retry.
connection.copyFailed: Copy failed. Retry or select the Tunnel ID above and copy it manually. No restart is needed.
settings.tunnelProxyAutoHelpLocal: Uses the Desktop environment proxy first, then detects running local proxies.

home.needTunnelCredentials: The runtime is ready. Save your Tunnel ID and Restricted Runtime Key in Settings.
home.needSecureLink: Tunnel credentials are saved. CodexLink is waiting for the secure link to become ready.

home.viewProjectHint: Review authorized local paths and access status

connection.simpleDescription: CodexLink manages the local runtime and Secure Link automatically; this page only shows real connection progress.
connection.configureCredentials: Open Settings to save Tunnel credentials
connection.secureLinkHelp: CodexLink uses the saved Tunnel credentials to establish the Secure Link.
connection.credentialsFirst: Save the Tunnel ID and Restricted Runtime Key in Settings first.
connection.createAppTitle: Create or add the CodexLink App
connection.createAppHelp: Once the secure link above is ready, follow the guide to create or add the App in ChatGPT. CodexLink handles the Server, Runner, ports, and Tunnel client automatically.
settings.tunnelHelp: After creating a Tunnel ID and Restricted Runtime Key, save them here once.
settings.networkAdvancedHelp: No changes are needed on a normal network. Open this only when Tunnel connectivity needs troubleshooting or you intentionally use a proxy.
onboarding.connectDescription: Create an OpenAI Tunnel and Restricted Runtime Key, then save both credentials securely in CodexLink.
onboarding.credentialStorage: The Runtime Key is stored only through CodexLink's protected credential storage and is never displayed back in the UI.
onboarding.chatgptDescription: Finish by adding CodexLink in ChatGPT. This step is guidance only and never marks an unverified connection as ready.
onboarding.chatgptStep1: Open ChatGPT Settings and go to Apps
onboarding.chatgptStep2: Enable Developer / custom App capabilities as needed
onboarding.chatgptStep3: Create or add the CodexLink App
onboarding.chatgptStep4: Choose the Tunnel you just configured and save
onboarding.credentialGuide: View Tunnel / Runtime Key illustrated guide
onboarding.tutorialPreviewHint: Images are shown as small previews. Click any image to enlarge it; click the empty area outside the image, use the close button, or press Esc to close the preview.
onboarding.tutorialUsageTitle: How to use CodexLink after setup
onboarding.detailIntro: Choose the screenshot set that matches your ChatGPT plan. Plus / Pro and Business use different entry screens, so both complete paths are included below.
onboarding.detail1: Open ChatGPT and go to Apps in Settings. The exact labels may change as ChatGPT evolves.
onboarding.detail2: Open the custom App / Developer entry and begin adding a new App.
onboarding.detail3: Use CodexLink and select the OpenAI Tunnel you created. Do not paste the Restricted Runtime Key into ChatGPT.
onboarding.detail4: Save and enable the App, then return to CodexLink for real connection status. One real project read is the final verification.
settings.onboardingHelp: Reopen the two-step first-use guide at any time. Viewing the guide never changes real runtime status.
